_comment: cc-tmux driven-CC hook template (§3.3-3.7). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the L2 hook layer. Deploy: merge this 'hooks' block into the driven CC's ~/.claude/settings.json, and copy cc-posttool.sh + cc-stop-check.sh into ~/.claude/hooks/. All hooks sit on NON-deny paths (PostToolUse/Notification/SessionStart/Stop-block) and degrade silently if a field/matcher name drifts. CLAUDE_SESSION_ID is EMPTY in hook env (CC v2.1.178) — hooks read session_id from stdin JSON instead. CRITICAL: stdin is consumed once — 'in=$(cat)' before any jq call. D-4 KEY UNIFICATION: the canonical per-session key is ${CC_TMUX_SESSION:-<stdin session_id>}; cc-start.sh injects CC_TMUX_SESSION=<tmux session name> so hook-written state aligns with the tmux-name-keyed files cc-monitor/cc-send/cc-finish use. Absent CC_TMUX_SESSION (a CC not launched by cc-tmux) it degrades to the CC UUID. CC must restart to pick up new hooks.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); k="${CC_TMUX_SESSION:-$sid}"; d="${CC_OUTPUT_ROOT:-/tmp/cc-output}/${k}"; mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null; resp=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_response // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ "${#resp}" -gt 4096 ] && printf '%s\n' "$resp" >> "$d/responses-$(date +%s).log" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

in=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); k="${CC_TMUX_SESSION:-$sid}"; printf '{"ts":"%s","event":"notification","session":"%s"}\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$k" >> "/tmp/cc-state-${k}.log"; touch "/tmp/cc-heartbeat-${k}"

in=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); k="${CC_TMUX_SESSION:-$sid}"; echo "[cc-tmux] 你是被 cc-tmux 驱动的 CC。session=${k}。约定:大输出(>8KB)必须 Write 到 /tmp/cc-output/${k}/ 下文件,不要只打进对话(scrollback 会丢)。最近状态:"; tail -3 "/tmp/cc-state-${k}.log" 2>/dev/null || true
